annotations.title: Find a compound, outcome or protein

description: Looks up the node id for a compound, protein, organism or outcome by name or synonym (for example "CoQ10", "caffeine", "CYP1A2", "sleep"). Use it to get the id that get_findings, get_finding, get_relations, get_reactions and reach take; for a question about what a substance does, call find_evidence instead, which needs no id. Returns up to 10 hits, each with id, label, type and the number of findings; hits with findings come first, so the first hit with findings above 0 is usually the one to use. An enzyme or transporter has type protein. It says nothing about a node beyond its id and how many findings it has. If with_findings is 0 the graph holds no findings for the name; the hits may still be the right node for get_relations, get_reactions or reach.

query.description: A name, synonym or short phrase, e.g. "CoQ10" or "vitamin D". One substance per call.
